types.name: on-model lifestyle shot
types.recipe: A single model wearing the product in a styled outdoor or resort-like setting. Usually vertical, cropped from the head to the bust, mid-thigh or upper thigh; sometimes horizontal and close to full body. The model is seated, leaning, reclining or moving, and either looks into the lens or has her face turned up with eyes closed. The background is softly blurred and at most one or two props echo the product's colours. Light is soft warm daylight or bright side sun, with a warm film-like grade. Some versions darken the background for a moodier, low-key look. Used as a single image in a card or beside a block of copy.
jobs: Mood image beside pricing or feature copy
Product card showing cut, fabric and fit on the body
Side panel or text background showing back view and tie details
Supporting product image beside manufacturer or solution copy
usedFor: home: Sunkissed Halter Top & Cheeky High-Cut Bottom Set

types.name: face-cropped torso detail shot
types.recipe: Vertical crop of a single model from about chin or eye level to upper thigh, with the face cut off at the top so the garment fills the frame. Shoot through soft foreground foliage or with a hand-held prop for depth. The background is blurred greenery or a pale wall. Light is warm, soft late-day sun with a slight golden haze. The image sits as a filler or side image next to text and shows print, piping, straps and construction clearly.
jobs: Product-detail image showing print quality and trim finishing
Get-started card focusing on top construction and print

types.name: torso detail triptych collage
types.recipe: A wide horizontal collage of three vertical panels side by side. Each panel is a tight torso crop of a different garment from the collarbone to the hips, with no faces. Each panel has its own bright outdoor location (sea, foliage, beach). Light is crisp direct sun, with visible texture such as water droplets. Used as one wide block to show the range of styles, prints and trims.
jobs: Proof of range and craftsmanship in a getting-started section

types.name: wide editorial lifestyle banner
types.recipe: A very wide horizontal panorama of one model, mostly full body. She reclines diagonally or sits with her legs stretched across the frame, against a textured setting such as sand, a stone wall or a garden patio. The shot can be eye level or straight overhead. Light is strong warm sun: golden-hour side light with long shadows, or hard midday highlights. Often one side is left as darker or quieter negative space for overlaid text. Used as a full-width section banner or page header, sometimes with rounded corners.
jobs: Section banner setting a premium, sun-washed mood
Hero or section background with empty space for text
Manufacturer section banner showing finished garments and trim

types.name: multi-model campaign hero with text gradient
types.recipe: A very wide landscape hero with two or three models in different styles, cropped around the thighs and grouped in the right two-thirds of the frame. They are seen from the front or the back, interacting casually with one large scene element in a vivid outdoor location. Light is bright hard midday sun with saturated colour. A dark gradient overlay fades the left third to near-solid so the headline and buttons can sit on it.
jobs: Home page hero behind the main headline
Solutions page hero background with room for headline and buttons
usedFor: home: Custom Swimwear Manufacturer In Bali

types.name: worker at work documentary photo
types.recipe: A horizontal medium shot of a real worker from the waist up, handling finished garments at a work table. Product stacks sit in the foreground and the blurred production floor is behind. Light is the factory's own even, cool overhead light with a neutral, unretouched grade. Placed next to process copy as proof of in-house production and quality control.
jobs: Proof of in-house production and quality control beside a sampling section

types.recipe: An eye-level photo of the production floor with no people, looking down rows of machines into the distance. One machine station sits sharp in the foreground. The space is bright and clean, lit by even fluorescent light mixed with window daylight, with little shadow. Shot both as a very wide banner and as a vertical crop of the same scene for a supporting image beside text.
